name: Home Screen Manager
description: TEST BUILD — Designs, orders, and renders hybrid Jellyfin/Abyss home sections using manual media, collections, metadata tags, and libraries.
overview: TEST BUILD — Home Screen Manager creation, ordering, rendering, and Abyss customization for Jellyfin 10.11.11.

versions.changelog: Adds Top 5 to the existing ranked-section choices, makes My List content headings activate the plugin's My List page despite Jellyfin's shared home URL, preserves native detail and library page spacing beneath persistent Top Row and message chrome, and applies ranked-number gradients across the visible number glyph.
